# doctor が一致させている2つの出力（container 1.2.2 / 2026-08-23）
# parseReclaimable: RECLAIMABLE 列の '数値 単位 (' に一致
# parseBuilder: STATE の running/stopped と MEMORY の MB/GB に一致

Images         126    2       98.83 GB  96.11 GB (97%)
Containers     2      1       2.75 GB   1.12 GB (41%)
Local Volumes  2      2       239.4 MB  0 B (0%)

$ container builder status
ID        IMAGE                                                STATE    IP                CPUS  MEMORY
buildkit  ghcr.io/apple/container-builder-shim/builder:0.13.1  running  192.168.69.23/24  2     2048 MB
⚠️  builder  the build VM has only 2048 MB — heavy builds (large multi-stage, big apt-get) can be slow or fail
            ↳ give it more: container builder delete --force && container builder start --cpus 4 --memory 8g
⚠️  storage  97.2 GB of images/volumes are reclaimable — not referenced by any running container, and untagged ones don't show in `container images ls`, so this can fill the disk unseen
